Place & perspective

City character. Coastal atmosphere.

The Egypt portfolio connects Fairmont Cairo, Mövenpick Resort El Quseir, Sofitel Winter Palace and Sofitel Legend Old Cataract photography. Films add perspectives from those properties and Rixos projects on the coast. City pages make it possible to follow each location through both still and moving images.

01

Hotel photography in Cairo

The Fairmont Cairo gallery is the starting point for our selected city work in Egypt. When planning hotel photography in Cairo, discuss how the collection should balance interiors, shared spaces and the wider identity of the property. The intended audience and the final layout help determine which views and details need priority.

02

Resort photography in El Quseir

Mövenpick Resort El Quseir provides the coastal counterpart in this portfolio. Its Red Sea location and Nubian-inspired architecture offer a different visual context from the Cairo project. For a resort photography brief, describe the balance you want between buildings, outdoor spaces, materials and the experience of being there.

03

A brief shaped around the location

An Egypt photography project should begin with the exact site, the spaces to be photographed, access arrangements and intended use of the images. Share a preferred time window and any visual references. Travel, scope and delivery are discussed for the individual commission, with the existing galleries helping establish the conversation.

Planning the shoot

Which Egypt locations are represented?

Photography collections cover Cairo, El Quseir, Luxor and Aswan. The film selection also includes Rixos projects in El Alamein, Sharm El Sheikh and Hurghada.

Can one brief cover city and coastal locations?

You can include both in your enquiry. List the sites, priority images and preferred dates so that travel and production requirements can be discussed together.
